RR-ENT-01.title: Rent Roll subscribable as its own product with editions and add-ons (§2.3); no other OFFICEX product required.
RR-ENT-01.acceptance: New org with only RR subscription completes UAT-41.

RR-ENT-02.title: Entitlement service: features enabled per org from subscription; checked server-side on every API call.
RR-ENT-02.acceptance: Calling a non-entitled endpoint returns 403 with feature code.

RR-ENT-03.title: Platform Core masters (properties, buildings, spaces, occupants, users) included with Rent Roll and editable from Rent Roll screens.
RR-ENT-03.acceptance: No CAFM screen needed to set up a property.

RR-ENT-04.title: Navigation built from entitlements and role; only subscribed products appear (fixes sidebar context bug).
RR-ENT-04.acceptance: RR-only user sees no FM, CRM or Marketplace menu.

RR-ENT-05.title: No hard dependency: every feature that can use CAFM/CRM/Marketplace data has a manual/CSV/API path (§2.4).
RR-ENT-05.acceptance: All UAT pass with only RR subscribed.

RR-ENT-06.title: Nightly usage metering: area under management, seat capacity, active contracts, client accounts.
RR-ENT-06.acceptance: Usage visible in Settings; exported to SaaS billing.

RR-ENT-07.title: Self-serve sign-up with 14-day trial, segment selection and configuration template (charge types, billing models, roles).
RR-ENT-07.acceptance: Trial org productive without OFFICEX staff.

RR-ENT-08.title: Full data export (Excel/CSV bundle + documents) on demand for the org or a client account.

RR-ENT-09.title: Upgrade/downgrade by entitlement change with no data migration; downgraded features become read-only.
RR-ENT-09.acceptance: Adding CAFM reuses existing spaces and occupants.

RR-ENT-10.title: White-label: logo, colours, templates, sender domain, subdomain; custom domain on Enterprise.
RR-ENT-10.acceptance: Invoice and emails show subscriber brand.

RR-ENT-11.title: Sandbox organisation with sample data (§13) for demos and training.

RR-ING-01.title: Upload .xlsx/.xls/.csv up to 20 MB, multiple sheets.

RR-ING-02.title: Downloadable standard templates per billing model (area, seat, charges-only).

RR-ING-03.title: Column mapping with auto-suggestions from synonym dictionary.

RR-ING-04.title: Save and reuse mapping templates per org and per client account.
RR-ING-04.acceptance: Second import of same layout needs no mapping.

RR-ING-05.title: Transforms: Indian number format, dates, sq m→sq ft, text→enum, escalation phrase parser.

RR-ING-06.title: Row-level validation with rule codes (Table 5.5a) and summary: passed / warning / failed / unmapped. Errors block; warnings need acknowledgement. File checks for duplicates and malware.
RR-ING-06.acceptance: Failed rows show rule, cell, fix hint.

RR-ING-07.title: Control totals for area, rent and seats reconciled to source.
RR-ING-07.acceptance: >0.5% variance blocks sign-off unless overridden with reason.

RR-ING-08.title: In-grid correction, downloadable error file, and re-upload into same batch.

RR-ING-15.title: Unmapped source columns preserved in staging and shown for review.

RR-ING-16.title: Data profiling report before mapping: duplicates, missing values, inconsistent dates/rates, totals.

RR-ING-09.title: Diff preview: new / changed / unchanged / ended.

RR-ING-10.title: Two-step commit: preparer submits, approver signs off.

RR-ING-11.title: Import versioning; rollback/void of a committed batch within 7 days.

RR-ING-12.title: Occupant de-duplication on GSTIN, PAN, fuzzy name.

RR-ING-13.title: Import opening balances (outstanding invoices, deposits held) at cut-over.
RR-ING-13.acceptance: Ageing matches client report at cut-over.

RR-ING-14.title: Bulk import API with identical validation.

RR-VW-01.title: Property rent roll: one row per space (vacant included) with totals.

RR-VW-02.title: Portfolio rent roll grouped by client account and property.

RR-VW-03.title: As-of date and Current / Contracted / Forecast views.

RR-VW-04.title: Filters: client, property, city, occupant, industry, contract type, billing model, status, occupancy, floor, area, rent, revenue component, expiry window, delinquency, critical.

RR-VW-06.title: Export Excel/CSV/PDF respecting filters and masking.

RR-CON-01.title: Create/edit contract through form with billing-model-aware fields.
RR-CON-01.acceptance: Seat fields shown only for seat/hybrid.

RR-CON-02.title: Approval workflow for new contracts and financial-term changes.

RR-CON-03.title: Renew, amend, serve notice, terminate as tracked transitions with documents.

RR-CON-04.title: Document repository per contract with versioning, status and visibility (§4.9).

RR-CON-05.title: Missing-document flag (e.g. active contract without executed agreement).

RR-CON-07.title: Lightweight deal register in Rent Roll (§4.7A); convert won deal into a draft/future contract copying terms and documents; same records used by Leasing CRM if subscribed.

RR-CON-08.title: Future contracts excluded from billing and collections until activated.

RR-CON-09.title: Maker-checker on every change to financial terms, with source clause reference.

RR-ESC-01.title: Generate all rent steps at contract approval from escalation terms.

RR-ESC-02.title: Escalation calendar with upcoming/due/applied.
RR-ESC-02.acceptance: All steps in next 12 months listed.

RR-ESC-03.title: Apply escalation with approval; notify occupant; update deposit requirement if top-up clause.

RR-ESC-04.title: CPI/market-review steps held as pending_resolution until rate entered.

RR-ESC-05.title: Expiry pipeline 0–30/31–90/91–180/181–365/365+ with renewal stages (discussion → LOI → agreement → renewed/lost) and revenue-at-risk.

RR-ESC-06.title: Lock-in end and notice-window dates computed from clauses.

RR-BIL-01.title: Billing run per period: draft invoices for all billable charges applying steps, concessions, inclusions and proration.
RR-BIL-01.acceptance: Draft total = rent roll billable total (reconciliation report).

RR-BIL-02.title: Separate invoices by invoice_group (rent, CAM, electricity, water, parking, services) and billing entity; optional consolidation per contract.

RR-BIL-03.title: Review, edit, approve; only approved invoices issue.

RR-BIL-04.title: GST-compliant invoice PDF: both GSTINs, SAC, place of supply, CGST/SGST or IGST, gapless numbering per entity per FY; branded.

RR-BIL-05.title: Metered utility billing from meter readings (manual, CSV, API or CAFM).

RR-BIL-06.title: Credit and debit notes linked to invoice, own numbering.

RR-BIL-07.title: Invoice delivery by email and WhatsApp with PDF and pay link.

RR-BIL-08.title: Bulk invoice generation as background job.

RR-BIL-09.title: GST e-invoicing (IRN, QR) per billing entity where enabled.
RR-BIL-09.acceptance: IRN on invoice via GSP sandbox.

RR-BIL-10.title: Turnover rent from occupant sales submissions.

RR-BIL-11.title: Late-payment interest as draft debit note per contract terms.

RR-PAY-01.title: Occupant can Pay All, Pay Selected, Pay Individual or pay a partial amount in one transaction.

RR-PAY-02.title: Allocation engine distributes one payment across many invoices.

RR-PAY-03.title: Auto-allocation priority configurable: selected invoices, oldest due first, or charge-type order.

RR-PAY-04.title: Manual allocation/reallocation by Finance with audit.

RR-PAY-05.title: Razorpay checkout and webhooks: signature-verified, idempotent.
RR-PAY-05.acceptance: Duplicate webhook creates no duplicate allocation (UAT-34).

RR-PAY-06.title: Offline receipts (NEFT/RTGS/cheque/UPI) and TDS credits recorded and allocated.

RR-PAY-09.title: Bank statement import for reconciliation suggestions.

RR-COL-02.title: Invoice dispute by occupant or staff creates task; invoice stays traceable.

RR-COL-03.title: Follow-up tasks and reminder cadence per overdue bucket.

RR-COL-04.title: Deposit ledger: receipts, adjustments, top-ups, refunds with approval.

RR-PRT-01.title: Occupant billing portal (§2.4) in subscriber branding; available without CAFM Tenant Portal.

RR-PRT-02.title: Occupant sees only own contracts, invoices and occupant-visible documents.

RR-FLX-01.title: Seat inventory by seat type per space; capacity roll-up.

RR-FLX-02.title: Pricing plan master (Premium Dedicated Seat, Enterprise Cabin, Hot Desk, Team Room, Virtual Office) with inclusions and extras.

RR-FLX-03.title: Seat billing bases: contracted, occupied, minimum commitment; hybrid base + seats + usage.

RR-FLX-04.title: Monthly seat count capture (manual, CSV or access-control/API) with approval before billing.

RR-FLX-05.title: Inclusion rules prevent billing included components (R-40).

RR-FLX-06.title: Per-use extras (meeting room hours, printing, parking) billed from usage entries or CSV.

RR-FLX-07.title: Short-term and rolling monthly memberships with notice in days; mid-month join/exit proration.

RR-FLX-08.title: Head leases as payable contracts with escalation and expiry alerts.

RR-FLX-09.title: Centre P&L: member revenue, head-lease rent, payables, opex, contribution, break-even occupancy.

RR-FLX-10.title: Managed Office dashboard: capacity, contracted, occupied, seat occupancy, revenue per seat, contribution margin.

RR-OPR-01.title: Client accounts under one subscriber, each with own properties, billing entities, numbering and branding.
RR-OPR-01.acceptance: Data of client A never visible under client B filters or to B's principals.

RR-OPR-02.title: Management mandates with services and fee rules.
RR-OPR-02.acceptance: Staff actions limited to mandated services.

RR-OPR-03.title: Invoices issued in the owner's billing entity name when mandate says so.
RR-OPR-03.acceptance: Owner GSTIN and series on invoice.

RR-OPR-04.title: Collections settle to owner's account per OI-6; operator sees reconciliation.
RR-OPR-04.acceptance: No pooled client money by default.

RR-OPR-05.title: Management fee computed per F-20 and invoiced to the owner by the operator's billing entity.

RR-OPR-06.title: Monthly owner statement (F-21) generated, approved, issued and archived; remittance recorded.

RR-OPR-07.title: Client Principal portal: own portfolio dashboards, statements, MIS, approvals.

RR-OPR-08.title: Operator-level consolidated view across clients (for operator management only).

RR-OPR-09.title: Mandate end revokes staff access to the client automatically; data export handed to owner.

RR-FMC-01.title: Charges-only contracts for occupants billed CAM/utilities/services by an FM entity.

RR-FMC-02.title: Meters and readings: manual, CSV, API; auto-sourced from CAFM when subscribed.

RR-FMC-03.title: Tariff master with validity dates per property and billing entity.

RR-FMC-04.title: CAM pools: annual budget, monthly provisional billing by apportionment.

RR-FMC-05.title: Actual CAM costs by category: manual, accounting import, or CAFM/Marketplace.

RR-FMC-06.title: Year-end CAM true-up per occupant (F-22) with debit/credit notes.

RR-ANL-01.title: Occupancy: area, seats and economic, by property/floor/client/portfolio.

RR-ANL-02.title: WALE by income and area; to expiry and to lock-in end.

RR-ANL-04.title: Revenue by component; top-tenant and industry concentration.

RR-ANL-06.title: 12-month forecast incl. escalations, expiries, renewal assumption and weighted pipeline.

RR-ANL-07.title: Property P&L: revenue, operating costs (manual/import/CAFM), NOI, margin.

RR-ANL-08.title: Automated monthly MIS (PDF + Excel) per property, client and portfolio; scheduled distribution.

RR-ANL-09.title: Exception centre: critical / action / upcoming / information, with assignment and resolution.

RR-ANL-10.title: Executive, property, managed-office, ageing, forecast and lease-pipeline dashboards with KPIs per Table 5.13a.

RR-ANL-11.title: Investor/lender pack export from a snapshot.

RR-ACL-01.title: Roles per Table 5.14a, inherited from Platform Core: Organisation → Client Account → Users → Roles → Properties → Spaces → Occupants → Contracts → Documents → Workflow → Audit.

RR-ACL-02.title: Record-level scoping by client account and property assignment.
RR-ACL-02.acceptance: Automated two-org and two-client RLS tests green.

RR-ACL-03.title: Field masking for PAN, bank details, contact data.

RR-ACL-04.title: Custom roles (Enterprise) built from capability list.
RR-ACL-04.acceptance: Custom role cannot exceed creator's rights.

RR-ALR-02.title: Escalation due at 90/60/30 days and on application.

RR-ALR-03.title: Lock-in end, notice window, renewal/break option windows.

RR-ALR-04.title: Holding over; missing LOI/agreement/amendment; document expiry (insurance, NOC, BG).

RR-ALR-05.title: Invoice pending approval; issued but unpaid; disputed.

RR-ALR-10.title: Owner statement due; mandate ending in 60 days.

RR-INT-02.title: Zoho Books API sync; QuickBooks; SAP/Oracle via CSV/SFTP.

RR-AUD-02.title: Platform audit_log for imports, approvals, billing runs, allocations, statements, exports, role changes, document views.

RR-AUD-04.title: GST export (GSTR-1-ready) and TDS receivable report.
